title: FoPvPToggle
description: Player PvP toggles with world and region rule controls.
body:
![FoPvPToggle cover image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KOtNWyCO/images/ab3e3bf01570549a9441db57bb43dc15443952d8.png)

FoPvPToggle gives players a clear `/pvp` switch while keeping server owners in control of where combat must stay enabled. Player choices are saved, blocked combat is handled across common direct and indirect damage paths, and admins can manage the important settings from an in-game editor.

## Features
- Let players use `/pvp`, `/pvptoggle`, or `/fopvptoggle` to turn personal PvP on, off, or check status.
- Block PvP both ways when either player has PvP disabled, including traced projectiles, TNT, end crystals, beds, and respawn-anchor explosions.
- Save each player's PvP state in `userdata.db`, so toggles survive restarts.
- Force PvP on during events with a global override that prevents players from disabling combat.
- Keep selected worlds outside the toggle system, where `/pvp` is unavailable and PvP stays enabled.
- Use the admin editor to manage default PvP, event override, PvE protection, FoBoss protection, disabled worlds, and forced WorldGuard regions.

![Disabled world selector for PvP toggle rules](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KOtNWyCO/images/85577db8af666393e069eaf59186a45046362eb3.png)

![Forced PvP region browser with WorldGuard regions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/KOtNWyCO/images/097bfd9280c83302bba97cc8c927d3619790fa10.png)

## Optional Integrations
- `WorldGuard` - browse regions in the editor and force PvP on inside selected regions.

## Commands
- `/pvp [on|off|status]` - Toggle or view your PvP state.
- `/fopvptoggle [on|off|status]` - Main command alias for the same player toggle.
- `/fopvptoggleadmin version` - Show plugin and update status.
- `/fopvptoggleadmin reload` - Reload config, messages, and GUI files.
- `/fopvptoggleadmin editor` - Open the in-game admin editor.

## Permissions
- `fopvptoggle.pvptoggle` - Use the player PvP toggle command.
- `fopvptoggle.admin` - Use admin version, reload, and editor tools.
